name: ToggleGroup
description: A group of pressable toggles (bold / italic / underline, alignment, or view switches) in single or multiple mode. Pressed items pop in a tinted fill with a spring, and in single mode the fill glides between items.
a11yNotes: role="group" labelled by `label`; each item is a native <button> with aria-pressed, and icon-only items get aria-label plus a title. Roving tabindex keeps one Tab stop: Arrow keys move focus (wrapping), Home/End jump to the ends, Enter/Space toggle. Fills are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the fill appears without scaling or gliding.

propsApi.name: type
propsApi.description: Allow one pressed item (pressing it again clears it) or many.

propsApi.name: preset
propsApi.description: Built-in item set used when `items` is not provided.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: React.ReactNode }[]

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next pressed values.

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: Floating toggles in a tray, or attached outlined segments.

propsApi.name: showLabels
propsApi.description: Show text labels next to icons.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
